# optLump

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/daankoning/optLump/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/daankoning/optLump/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

The `optLump` package provides a function to optimally lump together factor levels in a data frame.
This can be useful for reducing the number of levels in a factor variable, which can improve the fit and interpretability of a model.

For usage instructions, see `vignette("optLump")`.
